---
title: "Spanish Pool Owners Balance Clear Water Against Strict Safety Rules"
format: html
---

A recent [study](https://www.marknteladvisors.com/research-library/spain-swimming-pool-chemicals-market-report.html) by Markntel Advisor highlights that the Spain swimming pool chemicals report was valued at USD 156 million in 2025 and is projected to grow from USD 164 million in 2026 to USD 214 million by 2032, registering a CAGR of 3.40% during 2026–2032. The South holds 40% in 2026, while residential pools take 65% of pool types and tablets and granules take 60% of forms.
